openwrt_commit.titel: ramips: mt7621: add support for Cudy AP1300 Outdoor v1
openwrt_commit.Installation: The factory firmware is locked: you can only work with Cudy signed firmware. Download a intermediate firmware signed by Cudy here: https://www.cudy.com/blogs/faq/openwrt-software-download. After that, login to the router (192.168.10.254, password "admin") and install the intermediate firmware. If you can reach LuCI or SSH now on the intermediate firmware, just use the sysupgrade image with the 'Keep settings' option turned off.

openwrt_pr_16265.Beschreibung: Cudy AP1300 Outdoor is an outdoor unit with IEEE802.11ac and IEEE802.11 b/g/n radios
openwrt_pr_16265.Installation: Installation can only be done after the unlocked firmware has been installed. Unlocked firmware is available from Cudy on request or may be available on their website
openwrt_pr_16265.TFTP boot: Hold RESET for about 5 seconds while powering on and the device will request a "recovery.bin" via TFTP - TFTP server at 192.168.1.88, Filename: recovery.bin. The unlocked firmware is based on LEDE 17 and does not have LUCI so SSH/SCP sysupgrade should be used to upload the OpenWRT sysupgrade image - LEDE IP: 192.168.10.1, username/password: root/admin
openwrt_pr_16265.Kommentar DanielRIOT 2024-09-18: Indoor-AP1300 vermutlich gleiches Design, evtl. andere GPIOs/Switchports; Cudy schickt auf Anfrage ein LEDE-Image, das per Web-Firmwareupdate auch den Bootloader ersetzt

lauf.notiz: Nicht im ToH-Dump, ToH-Datenseite vorhanden, OpenWrt-Wikiseite fehlt. Aussengeraet IP65 (senkrecht), eine geschirmte GbE-Buchse, nur PoE (802.3af/at oder passiv 24-57 V, 48-V-Adapter liegt bei; Commit/ToH nur 802.3af 37-57 V). MT7621DAT, 128 MB RAM, 16 MB NOR. 2x2 MT7603E + 2x2 MT7613BEN, 2 abnehmbare RP-SMA-Antennen (WikiDevi: soldered). Seriell: unbestueckte Stiftleiste innen, 115200. Wichtig: MT7613 ohne DFS unter OpenWrt, Gluon setzt is_outdoor_device - 5-GHz-Outdoor-Betrieb fraglich (Gluon-Issue 3787). Widersprueche Hersteller: Leistung 11/7.5 W vs 18/5 W, passiv 24-57 vs 48-57 V, Knoepfe Reset vs Reset+WPS. Keine FCC-ID, kein Geizhals/EAN.
